title: Sizes Are Not Up To Standard
text: I was excited to see my first TNG shirt. I normally wear a 1x, but to be safe, ordered a 2x. Most shirts shrink a little anyway.  I was so disappointed to find it skin tight!  And I had yet to wash it. I was so disappointed.  Not willing to part with it, I wore it and stretched it out. But after the first washing, I couldn't even get it back on. Now it's too late to return it. Did I mention I was DISAPPOINTED! I am canceling my order for more.
label: negative
